vehicles.title: Vehicle catalogue
vehicles.intro: Makes, models and generations members pick their car from. Nothing a vehicle uses is ever deleted: deactivate it or merge it.

makes.caption: Makes in the vehicle catalogue
makes.empty_body: Create the first make or import the catalogue as CSV.

make.empty_body: Add the first model of this make.
make.error: The models could not be loaded.

model.empty_body: Without generations members only pick the model. Add generations with build years where they differ.
model.error: The generations could not be loaded.

merged_notice.body: This entry was merged. Its slug redirects and its vehicles now belong to

body.make: Active makes appear in the app right away.
body.model: The model appears under its make in the app's picker.
body.generation: Build years help members find the right generation.
body.brand: Members are offered part brands when they add a mod. Aliases catch other spellings.

fields.name: Name
fields.slug_hint: Leave empty: it is made from the name.
fields.slug_edit_hint: Can change only while nothing points at the entry.
fields.slug_locked: Locked: vehicles, mods or collections already point at this slug.
fields.popular: Show at the top as a popular make
fields.category_hint_hint: Where the brand is suggested first.
fields.reason_optional_hint: Optional, goes into the audit log.

aliases.label: Aliases
aliases.hint: Other spellings members type. Enter adds one, 20 at most.

deactivate_body.make: The make leaves the picker: members can no longer choose it for new vehicles. Existing builds keep it.
deactivate_body.model: The model leaves the picker. Existing builds keep it.
deactivate_body.generation: The generation leaves the picker. Existing builds keep it.

active.activate_body: The entry appears in the app's picker again.

merge.title: Merge “:name”

body.make: Pick the make that stays. Models, vehicles and requests move with it, the old slug redirects.
body.model: Pick the model of the same make that stays. Generations and vehicles move with it, the old slug redirects.
body.generation: Pick the generation of the same model that stays. Its vehicles move, the old slug redirects.
body.brand: Pick the part brand that stays. Mods move with it, name and aliases become aliases.

merge.survivor_hint: Each entry is listed with the number of vehicles it has today.
merge.option_brand: {1} :name · 1 vehicle with mods|[2,*] :name · :count vehicles with mods
merge.option_brand_inactive: {1} :name · 1 vehicle with mods · inactive|[2,*] :name · :count vehicles with mods · inactive
merge.outcome: {0} No vehicle moves to :survivor (it keeps :after). The slug “:slug” then redirects there.|{1} 1 vehicle moves to :survivor (then :after). The slug “:slug” then redirects there.|[2,*] :count vehicles move to :survivor (then :after). The slug “:slug” then redirects there.
merge.outcome_brand: {0} No mods move to :survivor (it keeps :after). “:slug” stays as an alias.|{1} Mods of 1 vehicle move to :survivor (then :after). “:slug” stays as an alias.|[2,*] Mods of :count vehicles move to :survivor (then :after). “:slug” stays as an alias.

no_candidates.make: There is no other make to merge it into.
no_candidates.model: This make has no other model.
no_candidates.generation: This model has no other generation.
no_candidates.brand: There is no other part brand.

merge.load_error: The impact could not be loaded.

delete.title: Delete “:name”?
delete.body: Nothing points at this entry. It is deleted for good.
delete.children_make: :models models and :generations generations go with it, all unused as well.
delete.children_model: :generations generations go with it, all unused as well.
delete.referenced: This entry is still in use and cannot be deleted:
delete.instead: Deactivate it so nobody picks it again, or merge it into the right entry.
delete.instead_brand: Merge it into the right part brand.
delete.load_error: Could not check what points at the entry.

refused.referenced: Still in use, so not deleted.
refused.slug_locked: The slug is locked: something already points at it.
refused.merged: The entry was merged and can no longer change.
refused.same_entry: An entry cannot be merged into itself.
refused.merge_level: Only entries of the same level can be merged.
refused.field_has_data: {1} The field has data in 1 mod. Archive it instead.|[2,*] The field has data in :count mods. Archive it instead.
refused.field_key_locked: {1} The key is fixed, the field has data in 1 mod.|[2,*] The key is fixed, the field has data in :count mods.
refused.field_type_locked: {1} The type is fixed, the field has data in 1 mod.|[2,*] The type is fixed, the field has data in :count mods.
refused.field_narrowing: {1} Refused: 1 stored mod would break the new rule.|[2,*] Refused: :count stored mods would break the new rule.
refused.fields_mismatch: The fields changed in the meantime. Reload the page.
refused.category_key_locked: {1} The key is fixed, 1 mod uses the category.|[2,*] The key is fixed, :count mods use the category.
refused.import_state: This import cannot be applied right now.
refused.import_file_changed: The file changed since the check. Upload it again.
refused.import_expired: The check is older than 30 days. Upload the file again.

requests.title: Catalogue requests
requests.caption: Requests from members

empty_body.pending: When a member cannot find their car, the request lands here.
empty_body.approved: Accepted requests appear here with their date.
empty_body.rejected: Rejected requests appear here with their reason.

requests.no_vehicle_hint: The member asked before saving a vehicle.
requests.reject_body: The member sees your reason in the app. Their vehicle keeps its free text.
requests.reject_hint: The member reads it in the app. 10 to 500 characters.

accept.title: Accept request
accept.body: Per level, pick the entry from the catalogue or create it.

none.model: The vehicle gets the make only.

accept.member_note: The member's vehicle is linked while it still carries the free text. The member gets the message “Your vehicle is now in the catalogue”.
accept.load_error: The catalogue could not be loaded.

brands.title: Part brands
brands.intro: Manufacturers members pick for mods. Merge the same brand in another spelling; aliases catch typing variants.
brands.caption: Part brands
brands.empty_body: Create the first brand or import the list as CSV.

normalise.title: Normalise spellings
normalise.body: Brands that are equal without case, accents and punctuation. The more exact spelling is suggested to stay. Nothing changes until you merge.
normalise.empty_body: Every part brand exists only once.

categories.title: Mod categories
categories.intro: The categories and fields of the mod form. Fields with data are archived, never deleted. Every change is kept as a version.
categories.caption: Mod categories
categories.error: The categories could not be loaded.

category.key_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and _, e.g. wheels.
category.icon_hint: Name of the auto glyph: wheel, tyre, coilover, exhaust, brake-disc … It shows on the right.
category.sort_hint: 1 to 63, also its bit in search.
category.empty_body: Without fields members only enter title, brand and note.
category.error: The category could not be loaded.

field.has_data: {1} 1 mod holds a value in this field. Key and type are fixed; narrower limits only work if every stored value meets them.|[2,*] :count mods hold a value in this field. Key and type are fixed; narrower limits only work if every stored value meets them.
field.no_data: No mod holds a value in this field yet.
field.key_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and _, e.g. diameter_rear.
field.pattern_hint: Regular expression the value must match.
field.options_hint: Value (lowercase letters, digits, _) and the label in both languages.
field.options_locked: Removing works only while no mod uses the option.
field.discover_body: Read-only: the Discover filters are fixed in this version. These flags change nothing in search.
field.reason_hint: Required: every change becomes a new schema version.
field.archive_body: New mods are no longer offered the field. :count stored values stay visible and in the export.
field.restore_body: The field is offered again, as an optional field. :count values are stored.
field.delete_body: No mod holds a value in this field. It leaves the schema, the versions stay.
field.delete_has_data: {1} 1 mod has data: archive|[2,*] :count mods have data: archive

order.hint: The order is the one of the form in the app.
order.active: Move the fields, then save the order.
order.title: Save the new order
order.body: This creates a new schema version.

preview.intro: This is the form as the app shows it, with its groups, units and placeholders. Archived fields are left out. Nothing here is saved.
preview.empty_body: Members only see title, brand and note.

history.initial_body: The state before the first change in the admin.
history.first: {1} Starting point with 1 field.|[2,*] Starting point with :count fields.
history.empty_body: The first change to the fields creates versions 1 and 2.

import.title: CSV import
import.intro: Vehicle catalogue or part brands as CSV, :rows rows and :mb MB at most. The check changes nothing; only “Apply” writes to the catalogue.
import.file_hint: UTF-8 or Excel CSV with ; or ,
import.rules: UTF-8 or Excel CSV, separated by semicolons or commas. Entries are found by slug, merged ones included. An import renames nothing and deletes nothing. The file is kept for 30 days.
import.apply_request: {1} 1 row: request approval|[2,*] :count rows: request approval
import.apply_body: :new new and :changed changed entries are written, as with a manual edit. :errors rows with errors are skipped.
import.waiting: Waiting for a second person to approve, until :until at the latest.
import.expired_body: The file is older than 30 days and was deleted. Upload it again to apply it.
import.partial_title: {1} 1 row was not applied|[2,*] :count rows were not applied
import.partial_body: The other rows are in the catalogue. The reasons are in the Result column.
import.failed_body: The file changed or the permission is missing. Rows applied already stay.
import.history_empty_body: Download a template, fill it in and check it here.
import.error: The imports could not be loaded.

codes.invalid_country: The country must be a two-letter ISO code.
codes.year_order: Year to is before year from.
codes.years_need_generation: Build years belong to a generation.
codes.duplicate: Duplicate: the same entry is in line :line already.

import.lines_later: The rows appear once the import has finished.
import.lines_missing: No rows are stored for this import.
import.result_skipped: Not applied: the row already had an error in the check.

flash.merged: Merged. The vehicles are moved over in the background.
flash.import_analysed: Checked. Look at the result before you apply it.
